external.title: External APIs
external.description: Create and manage custom API endpoints to receive data from external sources.
external.noEndpointsDesc: Create your first API endpoint to start receiving external data.

form.name: Endpoint Name
form.slugHint: Used in the public URL. Only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
form.responseTemplatePlaceholder: Optional: custom JSON response on success
form.webhookForwardUrlPlaceholder: Optional: forward received data to another URL
form.isActiveDesc: Endpoint can receive data when active
form.acceptedContentTypesHint: Requests with a non-matching Content-Type will be rejected with HTTP 415. "Accept any" is recommended for maximum compatibility.

detail.regenerateWarning: Regenerating the API key will invalidate the current key. External services using the old key will stop working.

logs.title: Received Requests
logs.emptyDesc: Send a test request or share the endpoint URL with your external service.
logs.previewDescOffer: Review the fields detected from this payload before creating the offer.
logs.previewDescSale: Review the fields detected from this payload before creating the sale.
logs.previewEmpty: No fields could be detected automatically. You can still continue and fill the form manually.

test.title: Test Endpoint
test.description: Send a test request to this endpoint.
test.descriptionDirect: Sends a real POST to the public URL with the X-API-Key header.
test.missingKey: No API key available. Click "Regenerate & use" to obtain a fresh key, or paste one manually.
test.invalidJson: Request body is not valid JSON.
test.noPlainKey: Backend did not return a plaintext key.
test.noKeyHint: The stored key is hashed and cannot be revealed. Click "Regenerate & use" to mint a fresh one (the old key will stop working).
test.bodySeededFromSchema: Body pre-filled from this endpoint's expected schema. All listed fields must be present and non-empty.

toast.createdDesc: Your new API endpoint is ready to receive data.
toast.urlCopiedDesc: Public endpoint URL copied to clipboard.
toast.keyCopiedDesc: API key copied to clipboard. Keep it secure.
toast.keyRegeneratedDesc: A new API key has been generated. Update your external services.

confirm.deleteDesc: Are you sure? This will permanently remove this endpoint and all its received data.
confirm.regenerateDesc: Are you sure? The current key will be invalidated immediately.
confirm.clearLogsDesc: Are you sure? All received request data will be permanently deleted.
